name: Prenoceratops
sum: Prenoceratops is a small leptoceratopsid from the Late Cretaceous of Montana and Alberta, known from a bonebed of juvenile and young individuals.
wsnote: Estimate in the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: TCM 2003.1.1, one of the few associated specimens of the bonebed — Two Medicine Formation, Montana.
material: Many disarticulated elements of many individuals; only skull material described.
biology: Small herbivore; the bonebed records many individuals together.
author: Chinnery 2004

sources.text: Chinnery, Brenda 2004. Description of Prenoceratops pieganensis gen. et sp. nov. (Dinosauria: Neoceratopsia) from the Two Medicine Formation of Montana. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 24(3): 572–590. doi:10.1671/0272-4634(2004)024[0572:DOPPGE]2.0.CO;2
